newsitem.title: INDIA: India shares end little changed before holiday.
newsitem.headline: India shares end little changed before holiday.

text.p: ** (1330 GMT) - Indian stocks close with little change,
markets cap early weakness to close sligtly higher
** Bombay's top 30-share index finishes 2.34 pts up at
** Trading mostly flat, thin volumes, say dealers
** Lacklustre trade ahead of Friday holiday at National
Stock Exchange, index closes 1.40 pts down at 1,057.80
** News about circulation of forged shares also puts damper
** Delhi share index falls 2.63 pts to 780.60, Calcutta
0.88 pts up to 455.16 and Madras 9.91 pts at 3,577.60
